Ajay P: FYI CoreWeave sent updated pricing/tenor options. They proposed 12/24/36mo reserved tiers with a higher spot floor for shorter commits. Asking if we want to model scenarios before partner call.
Kelsey R: Thx. Can you paste the sheet or the main numbers? even rough ranges are fine.
Ajay P: Pasted key rows below from their email: ```12mo commit => base $0.70/hr GPU, spot floor 60%
24mo commit => base $0.60/hr GPU, spot floor 55%
36mo commit => base $0.53/hr GPU, spot floor 50%
Ephemeral spot avg (no commit) => $0.32-$0.40/hr depending on seasonality```
Marta L: Good. We should convert those to $/token and $/inference-day under our typical workload assumptions. I'll run baseline convos (avg seq 512 tokens, 6 RPM per instance).
Tariq S: Also need to include marketplace fee split if this goes through cloud marketplace. CoreWeave flagged a 7% listing fee in the note. That shifts economics for short tenors.
CoreWeave Rep: Quick clarifier — marketplace fee applies only when billed through their marketplace SKU; direct reserved contracts can avoid it. We can provide both quotes.
Kelsey R: OK — for modeling, let's do 3 scenarios: conservative (marketplace on), mid (direct reserved + 7% passthrough), optimistic (direct + usage growth). Use commit amortization and expected utilization bands: 40%, 60%, 80%.
Ajay P: Will do. Any guidance on how to treat spot volatility? Their note said seasonal swings up to +/-18% on spot availability.
Marta L: Treat as two axis: price floor (their spot floor) and availability (affects effective capacity). Model a contingency: when availability <50% we fall back to reserved or cross-region routing at +10-15% latency. 
Tariq S: From GTM POV, we should also model reseller margin and discount ladders for customers buying Dedicated capacity. Put an MOQ assumption for 24mo commitments.
FlowBot: @Ajay P linked doc updated: https://redwood.internal/sheets/partner-cost-models#gid=42
Ajay P: Uploaded a draft tab with per-GPU $/hr -> $/request conversion using our standard perf numbers. Quick snapshot: 36mo @80% util => $0.0009/token, 12mo @40% util => $0.0021/token.
Kelsey R: Those deltas look right. Add a sensitivity table for token length (+/- 2x seq). Also include blended mix when we use spot for non-critical workloads (e.g., embeddings batch jobs).
Marta L: I'll add two eval prompts to watch quality regressions when falling back to quantized variants or different GPU families — cost wins aren't worth big quality drops.
CoreWeave Rep: One ask from our ops: can you indicate required burst capacity windows? If your traffic has 10x spikes we'll need to account for overprovisioning or cross-region failover cost.
Ajay P: Noted — will add spike scenarios (1.5x, 3x, 10x) and model short-term burst pricing.
Tariq S: Next step: finalize model by EOD Tue, then share with CoreWeave for a sanity check before the channel exec sync. Can someone own the finalize?
Marta L: I can finalize the model and the slide with 3 scenario visuals.
Kelsey R: I'll own the sensitivity write-up and the marketplace vs direct appendix.
Ajay P: I'll loop in legal on contract tenor language after Marta posts final. CoreWeave Rep — we may ping you for clarifications.
CoreWeave Rep: Sounds good. Happy to join the call Wed AM if useful.
Tariq S: Thanks all. Small action list: Marta final model, Kelsey sensitivity doc, Ajay legal handoff. :thumbsup:
Ajay P: Filing notes here so we don't lose them. Ping me if anything changes.
